title.zh: 修订第1200号共和国法第一编A部分“Af. Mindoro Oriental”目下第（9）项与第（29）项的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Items (9) and (29), Under “Af. Mindoro Oriental.” Title A, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred
title.orig: An Act Amending Items (9) and (29), Under “Af. Mindoro Oriental.” Title A, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred

text.en:
Items (9) and (29) under "af. Mindoro Oriental," Title A, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred are amended to read as follows:
"(9) Construction of Pinamalayan Central School ₱4,000.00" "(29) (a) Aid to PTA for the construction of Bulalacao Central School 1,000.00" "(b) Aid to PTA for the completion of Ranso Barrio School, Pinamalayan 1,000.00" "(c) Aid to PTA for the completion of San Agustin School Shop, Naujan
500.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
